assumptions.choice: Direct comparison of current bar close vs previous bar close (close[0] > close[-1] for long, close[0] < close[-1] for short)
assumptions.reason: Specification states logic is based on a direct comparison of the current price with the close price of the previous candle.
Specification dictates trading during high liquidity hours (10:00 to 16:00), which also inherently satisfies ignoring signals in the first 5 minutes after 09:30 open.

assumptions.choice: Allocate 99% of available cash divided by current price
assumptions.reason: Specifies 100% of available capital per trade; using 99% accounts for commission fees to prevent order rejection due to insufficient cash.

assumptions.choice: Evaluate 1% Stop-Loss and 2% Take-Profit in next() against bar High/Low relative to self.position.price
assumptions.reason: Evaluates intrabar price bounds for risk controls directly against entry price before checking signal crossover exits.
